conflicts.permit: To provide troubleshooting and customer support, we may need to access your information, such as your account email address.
conflicts.prohibit: On the server, your data is protected and not viewed or analyzed in any way.
conflicts.situation: When staff provides customer support or troubleshooting regarding user data stored on the server.
conflicts.reason: The policy broadly promises that data on the server is not viewed in any way, but subsequently states staff may need to access user information for troubleshooting.
